clean_story:
Now I will teach you Fire. It is hot like sun, but small and close. It eats wood and makes light, like stars in cave. It moves, it dances, it can hurt if touch. It makes food soft, like sun on fruit. It keeps cold away, like fur in winter.

Go now, learn heat, learn light, learn change.
